players.product: CUBIC modular power-distribution systems, motor control centers, medium-voltage drives and Logix controllers for data-center power, cooling and central utility plants

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K: fiscal 2025 (year ended September 30, 2025) sales were $8,342 million (fiscal 2024: $8,264 million): Intelligent Devices $3,756 million (segment operating margin 18.0%), Software & Control $2,383 million (29.7%) and Lifecycle Services $2,203 million (14.5%); North America sales were $5,270 million. Total order backlog was $2,878 million at September 30, 2025 versus $3,091 million a year earlier (Intelligent Devices $704 million, Software & Control $654 million, Lifecycle Services $1,520 million); about $800 million of remaining performance obligations was expected to be recognized over the next 12 months.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2025 sales $8,342 million; backlog $2,878 million (prior year $3,091 million)

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K: capital expenditures were $186 million in fiscal 2025 ($225 million in fiscal 2024) and Rockwell expected fiscal 2026 capital expenditures of approximately $270 million; fiscal 2025 free cash flow was $1,358 million. Rockwell says it maintains several single-source supplier relationships where alternative sources are not available or the relationship is advantageous.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2025 capex $186 million; FY2026 capex expected ~$270 million
